title: Front page
rule: A newspaper page: headline, a press photograph, a column of report and captions.
declares: keeps E0-E5, the four lines and the outcome
build: films/swarm/99-ways/build/p78_front_page.py (rol-cutout kit: kit/build_page04.py; agent print: kit/build_page01.panel_rest P7)

lines.question: Pardon me — have you the right time?
lines.answer: Ten past four, by the clock.
lines.forgetting: Well, here I am... and what for?

made: front page of an invented local paper, THE VALLEY LANTERN (ours), dated Friday, September 24, 1937 (the morning after): ears, masthead, dateline rules, all lettered in the shared pen hand (no font)
headline 'STATION AGENT FORGETS / ERRAND AT CUPBOARD', deck 'Brass Key Stays on Its Hook; SERVICE Door Not Opened'
one column of report (our copy) headed 'LADY ASKED THE TIME', carrying E0-E5 in order with the memo and the four canon lines quoted verbatim, ending with the outcome
press photograph: Rothstein's 1937 Randolph station (LoC 2017776101, reused from page 74), with caption 'THE SCENE...'
second block: the 99-ways-template rest layers P7 (Rothstein agent before the open cupboard, ANRC key on its HANDMADE hook, SERVICE card), captioned
third block: the Agence Rol 34852 woman (page 04's GrabCut cutout) as an outlined halftone, 'THE LADY AT THE WINDOW ... not identified'
every photograph printed through a HANDMADE 45-degree dot screen (block maker's tone curve), in news ink on a newsprint tint of the LoC 1934 sheet
a boxed small notice: 'LOST: one errand ... between the desk and the cupboard'; hand-ruled column rules; folio '78 / Front page'

events.E0: report paras 1-2 (memo, he rises for the key); headline
events.E1: report para 3 (question verbatim); deck 'LADY ASKED THE TIME'; lady block
events.E5: report paras 7-8 (forgetting verbatim, outcome); headline and deck

beat: the page made up on the stone, block by block: masthead; headline; press photograph; column (half, then whole); the two lower blocks with captions; the notice
beat_frames: b06 + agent and lady blocks with captions

self_check.check: A reader finds a headline and a news column carrying the events.
self_check.evidence: perceptually judged by the maker from the full-size page; blind reading pending

weaknesses: JPEG 1.22 MB, a little over the 1.2 MB target (dense pen lettering plus halftone); halftone dots softened to get there
the agent's face in the P7 block is blown out to bare paper and the key on the cupboard door is small and grey in the halftone; the caption has to point to it
the lady is the Rol 1913 woman (festive bonnet), not Bubley's 1943 figure, as on pages 04/73
body text at cap 35 px reads at full size but is small at phone width (headline and deck read at phone width)
